fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of system utilities (only grep and egrep for now) to discover security software discovery
fields.name: Security Software Discovery - Linux
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/grep" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/egrep") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "nessusd" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "td-agent" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "packetbeat" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "filebeat" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "auditbeat" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "osqueryd" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "cbagentd" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "falcond")))
